en.Nesse lago cai raio em até trezentas noi: This lake gets struck by lightning up to three hundred nights a year! And the last fact is the worst.

en.Numa noite forte, caem até vinte e oito: On a strong night, up to twenty-eight bolts hit every minute.
en.O Guinness diz que é o lugar com mais ra: Guinness says it's the most lightning-struck place on Earth: almost two hundred fifty bolts per square kilometer, every year.
